implementation: The existing recursive encode_data/encode_sequence and byte-writing helpers retain a generic SnapshotByteSink + ?Sized instead of erasing every concrete sink to a trait object. Encoder bodies and byte ordering are unchanged; dynamically dispatched callers remain supported.

Rust can specialize the same canonical encoder for length, fixed-buffer, vector and SHA256 sinks. Length-only measurement can eliminate byte conversion and indirect writer calls while preserving saturating arithmetic. There is no separately maintained payload-length formula.

The change is general Core encoding machinery, not a benchmark/name/alphabet specialization. It adds no cache, alternate representation, validation bypass, new account, unsafe code or separate runtime authority.
The canonical ProgramArtifact/catalog/compiler, real owners, capabilities, cumulative work and memory accounts, and one host round with atomic publication are unchanged.
